{{Quote|The Empire&hellip; I know the Alliance defeated most of them&hellip; But a lot of their forces didn't capitulate. They regrouped on my homeworld – Naldar! They're slaughtering my people&hellip;|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Vila]]|<ref name="SW92" />}}
The '''subjugation of Naldar''' by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The campaign==
===Initial assault===
{{Quote|Two years ago, while defending the rest of his family during the Empire's initial assault here, Prince Denin of Naldar was killed.|Princess Vila|<ref name="SW92" />}}
The initial assault of the Imperial forces on the planet Naldar took place in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Denin]] was killed while defending the rest of the [[King/Legends|royal]] family. However, his sister – Princess [[Vila]] – decided to impersonate her deceased brother in order to continue the fight. In spite of the early Imperial successes, Naldar forces managed to resist the invasion and the [[Naldar capital city|capital city]] was heavily fortified.<ref name="SW92" />

Following the [[Battle of Belderone (Galactic Civil War)|invasion]] of [[Belderone]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Flint]] joined the Empire and was placed in charge of the Naldar invasion force by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|281|Flint}}</ref> After the death of Vader, he would [[Duel on Vjun|become]] the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]].<ref name="ENDTSD" /><ref name="TCSWE" />

===Final assault===
{{Quote|The major assault on us came&hellip; not an hour after your squadron left here.|[[Foss (Naldar)|Foss]]|<ref name="SW92" />}}
[[File:LanLukVil.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Vila]] during a firefight.]]
After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Lumiya tasked Flint to conquer the entire [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]] and kill [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] while she prepared the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Nagai–Tof War|invasion]] of the galaxy.<ref name="ENDTSD" /><ref name="TFW" /> Thus, the final Imperial assault on Naldar came soon after the [[Declaration of the Alliance of Free Planets]]. Hearing news about the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] victory, Princess Vila came to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in order to require assistance from the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]. Soon after her departure, the Imperial forces managed to take the capital city and slaughtered most of its inhabitants.<ref name="SW92" />

Princess Vila, still impersonated her death brother Denin, was the only member of her [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to arrive safe on Endor. However, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] was unable to dispatch any forces, and the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] decided to go to Naldar with the Princess. As soon as they arrived, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was shot down by a planetary [[energy cannon]]. In the ruins of the capital city, they finally discovered the true identity of Vila.<ref name="SW92" />

[[File:Flint-MSW92.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Flint, the Dark Lord of Belderone.]]
The Rebels were then ambushed by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and in the ensuing fight, Princess Vila was killed. Luke Skywalker duelled Flint but Flint was eventually redeemed by his old friend [[Barney]]. A stormtrooper attempted to execute the Sith Lord for [[Treason/Legends|treason]] but was unsuccessful. Once the Imperial troops were defeated, Flint destroyed the planetary cannon before it could target other planets.<ref name="SW92" />

==Aftermath==
After rejecting the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]], Flint returned to his homeworld Belderone where he lived for years. He was eventually assassinated by his former master Lumiya.<ref name="TCSWE" />
